user.title: Adaptive Audio
user.description:
[Try these settings in your browser]({tester}) to see the day's volume as a chart. It opens with the settings saved here.

Sets the volume your speakers start at through the day. {sun}

data.max_rate: Never change the volume faster than

data_description.skip_sources: If a speaker is playing one of these inputs, its volume is never changed. Separate them with commas, for example: Line In
data_description.idle_gap: Once a speaker has been stopped this long, it starts at the scheduled volume the next time it plays. Shorter pauses keep your volume.
data_description.autoreset: Only matters when Adjust while playing is on. If you change a speaker's volume yourself, it stops following the schedule. 0 waits until it next starts playing.
data_description.max_rate: Playing speakers move toward the scheduled volume in 1% steps, at most this much each minute: while Adjust while playing is on, and when quiet mode turns off. Starting to play, turning quiet mode on and the night cap still change the volume straight away.

data_description.schedule_type: Morning, evening and night: set three volumes, and when each one starts below. My own times: type a list of times and volumes.
data_description.curve: Smoothly eases in and out. Steadily changes at an even rate. All at once jumps at the set time.
data_description.use_evening: Turn off to use only the daytime and night volumes.
data_description.points:
Only used with My own times. One per line: a time, then a volume. You can use sunrise or sunset, plus or minus minutes. For example:
07:00 20
sunrise+30 25
sunset-45 30
22:00 15

data_description.entity: Optional. Pick a time helper or a sun sensor, like Sun next rising. Leave it empty to use the time below.
data_description.time: Used when nothing is picked above.
data_description.ramp: How long the change takes, centred on the time. 0 changes it straight away.

data_description.entity: Optional. Pick a time helper or a sun sensor, like Sun next rising. Leave it empty to use the time below.
data_description.time: Used when nothing is picked above.
data_description.ramp: How long the change takes, centred on the time. 0 changes it straight away.

data_description.entity: Optional. Pick a time helper or a sun sensor, like Sun next rising. Leave it empty to use the time below.
data_description.time: Used when nothing is picked above.
data_description.ramp: How long the change takes, centred on the time. 0 changes it straight away.

data.quiet_entity: Also turn on quiet mode with
data.quiet_instant: Return to the scheduled volume instantly
data.cap_entity: Also turn on the night cap with
data.cap_start_entity: Or start at a time from
data.cap_end_entity: Or end at a time from

data_description.quiet_volume: The volume while quiet mode is on. Speakers can't go above it.
data_description.quiet_entity: Optional. Quiet mode is also on while this is in the state below.
data_description.quiet_instant: When quiet mode turns off, playing speakers jump straight back to the scheduled volume. Leave it off to turn them back up gradually, no faster than the rate in Speakers.
data_description.cap_enabled: Sets a maximum volume during the hours below. This is the same as the Night cap switch.
data_description.cap_entity: Optional. The night cap is also on while this is on.
data_description.cap_volume: Speakers can't go above this during night cap hours.
data_description.cap_start_entity: Optional. Pick a time helper or a sun sensor. Leave it empty to use the time above.
data_description.cap_end_entity: Optional. Pick a time helper or a sun sensor. Leave it empty to use the time above.

error.need_speakers: Add a name and at least one speaker.
